added.summary: The default style sets more surfaces as tokens, so a component or a pack names a value instead of writing one: --size-3xl to --size-7xl, --opacity-faint/dim/muted/soft, --filter-locked and --filter-spent, --font-leading-*, --font-tracking-*, --font-weight-*, --motion-easing-in-out and --motion-scale-press/swell/pop/shrink/breathe.
